title: Logical Operators
learningObjectives: Identify the operators, operands and result types involved.
Predict an expression's result by tracing it.
Use the topic in a focused program.
Avoid common mistakes and choose a clear alternative.

understand.concept: &&, || and ! combine or invert Boolean values. && and || short-circuit, so the right operand may not execute.
understand.whyItMatters: Accurate expression understanding prevents logic errors and improves safety, readability and maintainability.
understand.explain: Study logical operators through the rule summary and examples; trace values carefully and note type and edge-case constraints.

questions.prompt: When can a || b skip evaluating b?
questions.explanation: OR short-circuits on true left side.

questions.prompt: Why use short-circuit guard before accessing a risky expression?
options: The second operand may be skipped if guard fails
questions.answer: The second operand may be skipped if guard fails
questions.explanation: Guarded logic can avoid unsafe evaluation.
OR is true if any operand is true.
